correctness.rationale: For n>=3 use selected shores C_A,C_B and omitted-index sets P,Q. Each omitted a_i has I(C;a_i)=C_B\{b_i}, and omitted b_j has I(C;b_j)=C_A\{a_j}. Ordered difference of same-shore identifying sets forces P∩Q=∅ except P=Q={i}; the two disjoint size-n complement patterns leave a noncodeword undominated. For SLD, intersection of neighbors of identifying codewords forces all omissions to a single shore or one matched omitted pair. Counting per matched index gives D_DLD=z^n(z+2)^n-2n z^n+n z^(2n-2) and D_SLD=2z^n(1+z)^n-z^(2n)+n z^(2n-2). Both minima n; minimum counts 2^n-2n and 2. Checked n=3..6 by independently built graph neighborhood and literal definitions; n>=7 follows analytically, not from finite sampling.
